name: Kurama
description: (Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:titanic-size)The Nine-Tails, a giant demonic fox towering over buildings with immense physical and magical strength. It casually demolishes buildings, fires city-levelling Beast Bombs, and uses imprecise pyrokinetic and aerokinetic attacks. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
